items.prompt: Write the word equation for photosynthesis and state the role of chlorophyll in the process.

points.text: Places carbon dioxide and water on the left and glucose and oxygen on the right of the word equation
States chlorophyll traps the light energy that powers the building of glucose

items.prompt: Explain where the oxygen released by a leaf during photosynthesis comes from.

points.text: States the released oxygen comes from splitting water taken in by the leaf
States carbon dioxide supplies the carbon built into glucose, not the released oxygen

items.prompt: A meal contains protein, fat and carbohydrate. State which food group provides the most energy per gram and give one reason the diet is described as balanced.

points.text: Identifies fat as the food group with the highest energy value per gram
States a balanced diet contains all seven food groups in the right proportions for the person

items.prompt: Explain how the small intestine is adapted for absorbing digested nutrients into the blood.

points.text: States villi give the small intestine a large surface area for absorption
Links the thin villus wall and rich blood supply to fast movement of nutrients into the blood

criteria.name: Scientific explanation and use of evidence

levels.label: Secure
levels.descriptor: Explanations chain cause to effect in order, with each step justified by a named structure or substance.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Explanations are broadly sound but a link in the chain is asserted rather than justified.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: Answers name substances or structures without connecting them into an explanation.
